title: TritonBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Capabilities for Generating Triton Operators
authors_zh: Jianling Li, Shangzhan Li, Zhenye Gao, Qi Shi, Yuxuan Li, Zefan Wang, Jiacheng Huang, Haojie Wang, Jianrong Wang, Xu Han, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: Triton GPU 算子生成的双重程序化评测基准
best_for_zh: 需要评测 Triton 代码生成、性能优化或 GPU 算子正确性的研究者。
one_line: TritonBench evaluates generated Triton operators through 184 real-world kernels plus GPU correctness and efficiency profiling.
TritonBench 覆盖 184 个真实 Triton 算子，并用 GPU 执行正确性与性能剖析共同评测生成代码。
why: It distinguishes executable correctness from hardware-level efficiency instead of conflating them.
inclusion_reason: TritonBench exposes executable correctness and performance outcomes for generated GPU operators.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Triton offers Python-like GPU programming, but correct block partitioning, memory layouts, and parallel optimization still require substantial expertise. Strong performance on ordinary Python does not show that a code model can generate compilable, numerically correct, and efficient Triton operators. Existing kernel benchmarks also tend to focus on CUDA or a few handcrafted tasks, without systematic evaluation against industrial GPUs and PyTorch-style interfaces.

TritonBench builds two evaluation channels: 184 real Triton operators collected from GitHub and a collection of generation tasks aligned with PyTorch interfaces. The framework runs functional tests and efficiency measurements on widely deployed GPUs, subjecting model outputs to compilation, numerical-equivalence, and performance checks.

Triton 以 Python 风格封装 GPU 编程，但正确的 block 划分、内存布局和并行优化仍需要专业经验。通用代码模型在普通 Python 上表现较好，并不能说明其能生成可编译、数值正确且高效的 Triton operator；已有 kernel benchmark 又常偏向 CUDA 或少量人工任务，缺少面向工业 GPU 和 PyTorch 接口的系统评测。

TritonBench 构建两个评测通道：184 个来自 GitHub 的真实 Triton operator，以及一组与 PyTorch 接口对齐的生成任务。框架在广泛部署的 GPU 上运行功能测试和性能测量，使模型输出同时接受编译、数值等价和效率三重检查。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is the first comprehensive open benchmark for Triton-operator generation. Its real-world channel preserves 184 open-source implementations and invocation patterns, while its interface-aligned channel turns PyTorch operations into Triton-generation tasks. The repository provides task data, evaluation scripts, LLM outputs, and performance-metric directories. Each candidate is first checked for compilation and output correctness and then compared with a reference implementation on specified GPUs. Thus, records are not merely prompt–code pairs but operators, inputs, reference functions, candidate implementations, correctness states, and performance measurements for evaluation, SFT, feedback optimization, and cross-hardware analysis.

核心贡献是首个面向 Triton operator 生成的综合开放 benchmark。真实通道保留 184 个开源实现及其调用方式，接口对齐通道则把 PyTorch 运算转为待生成 Triton kernel；仓库提供任务数据、评测脚本、LLM 输出和性能指标目录。每项先验证编译与输出正确，再在指定 GPU 上比较 Triton 与参考实现的 latency。由此，数据对象不仅是 prompt—code，而是 operator、输入、参考函数、候选实现、正确性状态和性能记录，可用于模型评测、SFT、反馈优化及跨硬件分析。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect real operators: Independently runnable Triton operators are selected from GitHub projects, with dependencies, input shapes, data types, and reference outputs organized into a 184-task channel.
  1. Construct interface tasks: PyTorch operations are selected with fixed function signatures, requiring models to generate Triton implementations without changing external interfaces.
  1. Check execution correctness: Candidate operators are compiled and compared with reference functions over multiple inputs. Compilation failures, runtime exceptions, or tolerance violations fail.
  1. Profile performance: Latency, throughput, and relative speedup are recorded on fixed GPUs after warm-up and repeated trials, with correctness and efficiency reported separately. Triton, CUDA, driver, and hardware versions must be locked.

1. 收集真实算子： 从 GitHub 项目筛选可独立运行的 Triton operator，整理依赖、输入 shape、数据类型和参考输出，形成 184 题通道。
  1. 构造接口任务： 选取 PyTorch 运算并固定函数签名，让模型在保持外部接口的条件下生成 Triton 实现。
  1. 执行正确性检查： 编译候选 operator，在多组输入上与参考函数比较；编译失败、运行异常或误差超限均判为失败。
  1. 性能剖析： 在固定 GPU、warm-up 和重复次数下记录 latency、吞吐与相对加速，分开报告正确率和效率。复现需锁定 Triton、CUDA、驱动与硬件。

title: Evidence
证据
html: TritonBench evaluates multiple state-of-the-art code LLMs on both real-world and interface-aligned channels with uniform compilation, numerical testing, and GPU profiling. The paper finds that current models already struggle to produce correct operators and that functionally valid outputs often fail to deliver stable speedups, showing that performance is not reducible to correctness. The 184 real operators add source diversity, while the PyTorch-aligned channel supports controlled comparisons. This demonstrates the benchmark’s ability to expose high-performance-code gaps, but model rankings and speed conclusions are tied to the evaluated GPUs and require remeasurement on other architectures.

TritonBench 用真实通道和接口对齐通道评测多种 SOTA code LLM，并对所有候选执行统一编译、数值测试和 GPU profiling。论文发现现有模型在正确 operator 生成上已明显困难，即使功能通过，也常无法获得稳定加速，说明性能指标并未被正确率替代。184 个真实算子增加了来源多样性，PyTorch 通道则支持受控比较。该证据证明 benchmark 能揭示高性能代码缺口，但论文的模型排名与速度结论绑定测试 GPU；跨架构部署仍需重新测量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: KernelBench evaluates general GPU-kernel generation from PyTorch workloads, while earlier Triton data largely consist of tutorials or code from individual projects. TritonBench combines Triton language requirements, real open-source operators, and interface-aligned tasks in one evaluation, recording both correctness and efficiency on industrial GPUs. It is not the first work to measure kernel latency, but it establishes the first dual-channel, batch-runnable public protocol for Triton operators. Unlike code benchmarks that report only pass@k, it treats performance regression as a distinct failure mode.

KernelBench 从 PyTorch workload 评测通用 GPU kernel 生成，而早期 Triton 数据多是教程样例或单个项目代码。TritonBench 的实际变化是把 Triton 语言规范、真实开源 operator 和接口对齐任务放进同一评测，并同时记录工业 GPU 上的正确性和效率。它不是首次测量 kernel latency，但首次为 Triton operator 建立双通道、可批量运行的公开协议。相较只看 pass@k 的代码基准，它把性能退化视为独立失败模式。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Source contamination: GitHub operators may have appeared in model pretraining, so the real-world channel cannot fully exclude memorization. Code similarity should be reported, with recent or rewritten tasks evaluated separately.
  1. Hardware specialization: Triton configurations are sensitive to GPU architecture and input shape; one implementation cannot be optimal everywhere. Results should be stratified by hardware, shape, and dtype.
  1. Test coverage: Numerical equivalence on finite inputs does not guarantee boundary shapes, non-contiguous memory, or extreme-value stability. Property tests and randomized perturbations should be added before reuse.

1. 来源与重复： GitHub operator 可能在模型预训练语料中出现，真实通道不能完全排除记忆。应报告代码相似度并单列新近或重写任务。
  1. 硬件特化： Triton 配置对 GPU 架构和输入 shape 敏感，一个实现不可能在所有设备最优。评测应按硬件、shape 和 dtype 分层。
  1. 测试覆盖： 有限输入的数值等价不能保证边界 shape、非连续内存或极端数值稳定性。复用前应增加属性测试和随机扰动。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Triton-model evaluation: Report compilation, functional pass rate, average speedup, and regression rate separately on both channels rather than collapsing them into one score.
  1. SFT and RL: Learn from real operators, use reference tests as hard verifiers, and reward speed ratios. Safeguards must prevent false speedups from reduced precision or changed interfaces.
  1. Performance agents: Let models iteratively adjust block sizes, num_warps, and memory access from compiler logs and profiler results. A new baseline is required when the target GPU differs from the benchmark hardware.

1. Triton 模型评测： 在两个通道分别报告编译率、功能通过率、平均加速和性能退化比例，不能只合并为单一分数。
  1. SFT 与 RL： 用真实 operator 做代码学习，以参考测试为硬 verifier、速度比为奖励；需防止通过减少精度或修改接口获得虚假加速。
  1. 性能 agent： 让模型读取编译日志和 profiler 结果迭代调整 block size、num_warps 和内存访问。若目标 GPU 与 benchmark 不同，必须重新建立基线，不能直接复用论文速度标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: TritonBench systematically evaluates compilation, correctness, and GPU efficiency of model-generated Triton operators.
  2. Method takeaway: A real GitHub channel, PyTorch-interface channel, numerical checks, and hardware profiling are central.
  3. Data takeaway: It contains 184 real operators plus interface-aligned tasks, LLM outputs, and performance-metric directories.
  4. Evidence anchor: State-of-the-art models have substantial gaps in both correctness and stable acceleration, with results bounded by evaluated GPUs.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits Triton SFT/RL; contamination checks, cross-hardware retesting, and boundary-input audits are required.

1. 一句话定位： TritonBench 系统评测模型生成 Triton operator 的编译、正确性和 GPU 效率。
  2. 方法抓手： 真实 GitHub 通道、PyTorch 接口通道、数值检查与 hardware profiling 是核心。
  3. 数据抓手： 184 个真实算子，另有接口对齐任务及 LLM 输出和性能指标目录。
  4. 证据锚点： SOTA 模型在正确率和稳定加速上均有明显缺口，结果受测试 GPU 限制。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 Triton SFT/RL；使用前需做污染检查、跨硬件重测与边界输入审计。
